data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Clarify that this test targets draft-9's EXTENDED conflict_resolver API — draft-9 introduces per-element provenance with Mutation emission for collection-with-provenance fields (comments, labels, watchers, links). The 6-case matrix from draft-9 produces Mutation entries that we inspect for (target='label', payload starts 'dso-id-', action in {create, update}). If the current conflict_resolver.py (pre-draft-9) lacks Mutation emission, this task's prerequisite is draft-9 — add depends_on: draft-9 story 26de-eb67-29d2-48ae completed before this task can run. Document the 6 case names explicitly: (a) inbound-comment-create, (b) outbound-comment-create, (c) comment-edit-bidirectional, (d) comment-delete-bidirectional, (e) label-create-edit-delete-bidirectional (excluding dso-id), (f) link-create-edit-delete-bidirectional.
